title: What dog breed am I? Free personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free "what dog breed am I" quiz: answer 12 questions to find which dog matches your personality, from golden retriever and border collie to husky, corgi, poodle and beagle. No sign-up.
lede: Are you a loyal German shepherd, a fierce little chihuahua or a dramatic husky? Answer 12 questions about your weekends, friends and work style to find the dog breed that matches your personality.
about: Dog breeds have famous personalities: golden retrievers are known as friendly and eager, border collies as tireless and clever, huskies as adventurous and vocal. Real dogs are individuals, of course, but breed stereotypes make a fun mirror for human personalities. This quiz matches you with eight breeds: golden retriever, border collie, German shepherd, chihuahua, Siberian husky, corgi, poodle and beagle.

Your result names your breed and shows your scores for all eight. The quiz was written for cv.cm and is just for fun. If you are choosing a dog to live with, the pet match test on this site looks at your home, time and allergies instead.

faq.q: Which dog breeds can I get?
faq.a: Golden retriever, border collie, German shepherd, chihuahua, Siberian husky, corgi, poodle and beagle.

faq.q: Is one breed rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every breed appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Does this tell me which dog I should get?
faq.a: No, it matches breeds to your personality for fun. A dog to live with depends on your space, time, budget and allergies; try the pet match test on this site for that.

faq.q: Why isn't my favorite breed here?
faq.a: Eight results keep the quiz short and fair. More breeds may join in a later update.

golden.name: Golden retriever
golden.body: You are warm, friendly and endlessly optimistic. You make everyone feel welcome and see the best in people. Just remember that not everyone deserves your trust straight away.

collie.name: Border collie
collie.body: You are brilliant, driven and always busy. Give you a problem and you'll solve it before anyone else has finished reading it. Learn to rest: a switched-off mind comes back sharper.

shepherd.name: German shepherd
shepherd.body: You are loyal, disciplined and protective. People rely on you because you show up, stay calm and do the job right. Let yourself be looked after too.

chihuahua.name: Chihuahua
chihuahua.body: You are small in nobody's eyes but your own. Bold, sassy and fiercely devoted, you say what you think and stand up for your people. Save the fight for battles that matter.

husky.name: Siberian husky
husky.body: You are adventurous, energetic and a little dramatic. You need space, movement and freedom, and you make life more exciting for everyone around you. Find outlets for that energy and you'll thrive.

corgi.name: Corgi
corgi.body: You are cheerful, charming and secretly a bit bossy. You brighten every room and know exactly how to get your way. Use that charm for good.

poodle.name: Poodle
poodle.body: You are smart, elegant and quietly confident. You like things done well and have excellent taste. Don't let perfectionism stop you from enjoying a little mess now and then.

beagle.name: Beagle
beagle.body: You are curious, sociable and led by your nose, often toward food. You notice everything and make friends wherever you go. Follow your curiosity, but finish one trail before starting the next.
